newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Suncrop-Metway says TCD issue well received.
newsitem.headline: Suncrop-Metway says TCD issue well received.

text.p: Suncorp-Metway said on Tuesday that its A$250 million of transferable certificates of deposit announced last week were priced at 42 basis points over the March 2002 government bond.
The issue matures March 15, 2002 and pays a coupon of 6.0 percent.
"The issue is in line with group's overall wholesale funding strategy," said Caji De Souza, chief financial officer at Suncorp-Metway.
"It has been extremely well received and continues to expand a new market of investors to the group," De Souza said.

The transaction was jointly lead managed by Bankers Trust Australia Ltd, BZW Australia Securities Ltd, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Australia Ltd, SBC Warburg Australia Ltd and Westpac Banking Corporation.
These lead managers also comprise the new dealer group of the issuer's recently announced domestic TCD programme.
